testAdaptations: Baseline log constant redirects output only to task work.
Backpressure case only: heartbeat30s ->200ms in both compared sources; five4MiB payloads, upstream pauses500ms.
Truncated SOCKS reply case only: connect timeout5000ms ->200ms; retry delay and retry count unchanged.
SOCKS fixture records real official target bytes but forwards to its own local raw-key DC fixture; no public-network DC contact.
Tunnel test guard rejects nonowned/nonloopback TCP and all hostname DNS lookup; numeric loopback is returned locally for Node listen.
Gateway deadline/cooldown cases source-copy15/30s->150ms; no production timeout changes.
Gateway capacity reaches504 in batches24; does not claim504 simultaneous incoming SYN stability.
Gateway factories inject resolver/local SOCKS backend only; stdin has no test hooks.
Production gateway socket test forbids all direct/outside-loopback TCP and external OS DNS.
37 gateway +47 bridge rerun after moving fixtures out of gitignored scripts/tests into scripts/regression.
limits: Local health confirms process/protocol, not remote reachability or VPN encryption.
Autonomous app-local DoH/DPI uses IPv4 TCP and OS routing; it does not reproduce Zapret UDP QUIC/Discord/STUN/game packet tricks or create an encrypted remote VPN.
Other app outbound paths, Chromium/updater DNS, actual personal provider and clean-PC operation require root built-app gates.
Already active global Lagom WinDivert can still modify app outbound packets, so live success on this host does not prove independent ciadpi effectiveness.
Dynamic Telegram DC/CDN endpoints are not wired to bridge.
No real account/media/post/send test in this subtask.
No hours-long full-capacity heavy-stream load, multiGiB, sleep/wake or physical-network/VPN matrix.
Previously observed ciadpi partialHTTP response defect is not fixed by this unchanged binary.
Loopback services and Origin checks are not security boundaries against malware with the same user privileges.
